“how is it different from other government portals? myScheme is a national platform for accessing a wide range of government schemes from both the Central & State/UT Governments. It is a one-stop platform for search & discovery of government schemes based on demographic details. Unlike traditional government portals, myScheme brings together schemes from the Central Government, State Governments, and Union Territories on a single platform and helps users find relevant schemes based on their eligibility. How will myScheme help common citizens? The myScheme platform simplifies access to government schemes by enabling citizens to discover relevant schemes in one place, eliminating the need to visit multiple departmental websites or review extensive scheme guidelines to check their eligibility. How does myScheme work? The myScheme platform follows a simple and user-friendly three-step process to help citizens discover government schemes for which they are eligible: Step 1: The user enters basic details such as demographic, income, social category, etc. Step 2: Based on the information provided, myScheme displays relevant schemes from hundreds of government schemes for the user. Step 3: The user can select” [1]
